## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-4-daef8450`

In `TankSnapshot::from_state` (snapshot.rs:76-87), the snapshot reads `ph` from the cached `state.water.ph` (line 87) but reads `co2_aq_mmol_per_l` from a freshly re-solved `solve_carbonate_equilibrium` call (lines 76-81). If the state is ever produced on stale inputs (DIC/Alk mutated without a resolve call), the pH and CO2 in the snapshot would be mutually inconsistent. Since the solver is deterministic and all current paths maintain consistency this is safe today, but using `carbonate_eq.ph` instead of `state.water.ph` for the snapshot's `ph` field would make the snapshot self-consistent by construction and eliminate the coupling to the resolve-before-snapshot precondition.

### `fr-4-f8f0a292`

The `bicarbonate_mg_per_l` field in `SourceWaterProfile` (source_water.rs:25) is set during `WaterState::from_source_profile_for_volume_l` (water.rs:105) but immediately overwritten by `resolve_carbonate_state` (water.rs:110). During water changes, only DIC and alkalinity from the source profile are mixed in — `bicarbonate_mg_per_l` is not used. The field is effectively dead input for chemistry but is still validated and carried through presets. Add a code comment on the field documenting that it is display/documentation only and not an authoritative chemistry input, to prevent future developers from tuning it expecting it to affect equilibrium behavior.

### `fr-4-3548e7f8`

Do not seed `animal.reserve_g` from live shrimp counts in `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:333-369`. `reserve_g` is a separate stored material pool, not the structural biomass already represented by `adults_count`/`juveniles_count`: it is counted independently in the elemental budgets (`crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:246-248`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:332-333`) and can be spent to create new shrimp biomass (`crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:639-657`). Reconstructing it from existing shrimp counts injects extra N/C into every migrated v3 save and can immediately fund hatching/maturation that the saved state never actually contained.

### `fr-4-994ca774`

Rework the new detritus-appetite cap in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:148-165` to use one consistent mass basis. `food_demand`/`periph_consumed` are raw periphyton biomass grams, but `detritus_consumed` and `daily_food_consumed_g` are organic-matter routing grams (`crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs:86-89`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:379-385`). Because the remainder is computed as `food_demand - periph_consumed`, detritus-heavy diets can still overshoot the intended daily intake cap by roughly 4x at the default N:C ratio, and the added regression test at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:835-871` currently encodes the same mixed-unit expectation.
